elements.name: Darkvision (60 ft.)
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

elements.name: Draconic Flight
elements.desc: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Darkvision (120 ft.)
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

elements.name: Dwarven Resilience
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

elements.name: Dwarven Toughness
elements.desc: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

elements.name: Stonecunning
elements.desc:
As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Fey Ancestry
elements.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

elements.name: Keen Senses
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

elements.name: Trance
elements.desc: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

elements.name: Gnomish Cunning
elements.desc: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

elements.name: Large Form
elements.desc: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Powerful Build
elements.desc: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

elements.name: Brave
elements.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

elements.name: Halfling Nimbleness
elements.desc: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

elements.name: Luck
elements.desc: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

elements.name: Naturally Stealthy
elements.desc: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

elements.name: Resourceful
elements.desc: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Skillful
elements.desc: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

elements.name: Versatile
elements.desc: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Skilled is recommended.

elements.name: Adrenaline Rush
elements.desc:
You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

elements.name: Relentless Endurance
elements.desc: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Otherworldly Presence
elements.desc: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

elements.name: Breath Weapon: Acid
elements.desc:
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 acid damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

elements.name: Damage Resistance: Acid
elements.desc: You have Resistance to acid damage, as determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

elements.id: Racial Trait:Wood Elf: Movement Speed Increase
elements.name: Wood Elf: Movement Speed Increase
elements.desc: Your Movement Speed increases to 35 feet.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Cloud's Jaunt
elements.desc: As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Fire's Burn
elements.desc: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Frost's Chill
elements.desc: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Hill's Tumble
elements.desc: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Stone's Endurance
elements.desc: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.

elements.name: Giant Ancestry: Storm's Thunder
elements.desc: When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

elements.name: Damage Resistance: Necrotic
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
